newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan credit banks announce BIS ratios, latent prft.
newsitem.headline: Japan credit banks announce BIS ratios, latent prft.

text.p: Japan's three long-term credit banks on Monday announced their capital adequacy ratios and unrealised profits on shareholdings as of March 31.
The three banks are the Industrial Bank of Japan Ltd (IBJ), the Long-Term Credit Bank of Japan Ltd (LTCB) and Nippon Credit Bank Ltd (NCB).

Under rules set by the Bank for International Settlements (BIS), Japanese banks operating internationally must have capital equivalent to eight percent of risk-weighted assets.
Japan allows banks to include unrealised profits on shareholdings as part of their capital.
